summary_en: 25,000 shares (0.71% of S/O), ¥331.0M limit, ToSTNeT-3 block on 26 Aug 2026 08:45 JST at closing price ¥13,240/share.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 25 August 2026, Kimura Kohki's board authorized a single-day off-hours block purchase of up to 25,000 treasury shares (0.71% of 3,535,286 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥331.0 million. The purchase will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 at the day's closing price of ¥13,240/share on 26 August 2026 at 08:45 JST. The order is time-limited to the specified trading window; partial execution or no execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be announced after the trading session closes. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to operating conditions.
